# Search Requirements Quality Checklist: Search Bookmarks by Title

**Purpose**: Review whether the search matching rules and the paging/list-parity requirements are complete, clear, consistent and testable before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Focus: search matching rules; paging and parity with the bookmark list. Depth: Standard. Audience: Reviewer (PR).

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the fields a search is matched against stated exhaustively (title only, explicitly not link or tags)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the rule for a search with several words (all words, any order) stated in a requirement rather than only in a scenario? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the behavior for a search word repeated in the same search ("guide guide") specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the response fields of a search page (items, total, limit, next-page token) specified, or explicitly inherited from the bookmark list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is it specified what `total` counts when search and tag are combined (matches of both, not of either)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for a search sent with the removed offset option? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, US3-4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "word" defined precisely enough to decide hyphenated, apostrophe, underscore and digit cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications Q2]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "letters (any alphabet)" bounded, for example whether numeric symbols such as "½" or combining accents count as letters? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, research.md]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "ignores letter case" specified for non-English letters (for example "Σ" and "σ", "Ü" and "ü")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the 200-character limit defined as counting the raw search as sent, before trimming separators? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "whole word" stated unambiguously for titles where a word is followed by digits ("Python3" vs "python")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "pages the same way the bookmark list does" made concrete with the default size, maximum size and token behavior rather than by reference only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Are the word rule in the Edge Cases, FR-003 and Clarification Q2 worded consistently, with no leftover "spaces and punctuation" phrasing that suggests a different rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the statement that the bookmark list is unchanged (FR-011) consistent with the plan's change to the shared list query function? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the tag rules for search (normalization, validation, errors) consistent with the bookmark list's tag rules in specs/001? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the accepted-token behavior for a different search or tag (Clarification Q3) consistent with the "never repeated or skipped" guarantee, which applies only to one unchanged search? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 - Does every functional requirement FR-001 to FR-011 have at least one acceptance scenario or edge case that can decide it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001..§FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is SC-002 ("only bookmarks whose titles match, and every bookmark whose title matches") measurable with a defined set of test cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-004 (first page in under one second at 100,000 bookmarks) tied to a defined data shape (how many matches, how many words)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the expected error details (which field is named) specified for each invalid search input, or only "an error explaining what is allowed"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, US1-5]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for a search that matches exactly one page of results (no next-page token)? [Coverage, Spec US3]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for deletes between search pages, as well as saves? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, US3-3]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is a scenario defined where a bookmark matches the tag but not the words, and the reverse? [Coverage, Spec US2]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are scenarios defined for a search combining a cursor with a tag across pages? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Is the result specified for a search whose only word is a single letter or digit ("a", "3")? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the result specified for a search word that can never match a title word (for example a symbol counted as a letter in the search but not in titles)? [Edge Case, Gap, research.md]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the behavior for a search of exactly 200 characters, and of 201, specified at the boundary? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 - Is the assumption "accents are not ignored" stated as a requirement a test can check, not only as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the dependency on specs/001's tag, page size and token definitions referenced with the specific requirements it inherits? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
